annotations.title: Chinese zodiac for a birth date

description: The Chinese zodiac animal (生肖), element and yin/yang for a birth date, computed correctly at the boundary: by the popular Lunar New Year rule and by the Start of Spring (立春) rule used in BaZi. Also gives the lunar birthday. Covers questions like 'what is my Chinese zodiac', 'what animal is someone born in January 1990', '我属什么', '生肖'.

birth_city.description: Optional. City of birth, e.g. 'Taipei' or 'Paris, France'.

birth_timezone.description: Optional. IANA timezone of the birth place, if no city.

name: get_chinese_zodiac
